title: 2026 UK greenhouse-gas methodology change QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The planned-method note says its estimates were provisional until the 5 February 2026 final statistical release.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat method-note impact estimates as final values after a later final release exists.

facts.source_fact: The planned-method note covers method changes and generally does not include revisions to activity data sources such as DUKES unless stated.
facts.expected_handling: Separate method-change effects from source-data revisions.

facts.source_fact: The method-change note uses UK geographic coverage excluding Crown Dependencies and Overseas Territories unless stated otherwise.
facts.expected_handling: Attach geography before comparing totals.

facts.source_fact: Final territorial statistics are derived from the UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory used for UNFCCC reporting.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve inventory and reporting-basis provenance.

facts.source_fact: Method improvements are applied back through the time series so the trend from 1990 uses a consistent method.
facts.expected_handling: Do not splice unrevised historic values into a revised series.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 method changes were estimated to reduce 1990 UK emissions and slightly increase 2023 emissions before finalisation.
facts.expected_handling: Treat method impacts as vintage-specific revisions, not new activity observations.

facts.source_fact: The landfill model was updated to use GDP as a proxy for solid-waste disposal where pre-1997 activity data are unavailable.
facts.expected_handling: Flag proxy-derived historic waste activity separately from observed activity.

facts.source_fact: Domestic-wastewater parameters and emission factors were updated using the 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines plus UK-specific assumptions.
facts.expected_handling: Record the guideline version and UK-specific supplements.

facts.source_fact: Domestic shipping movement estimates are normalised to DUKES fuel-sales totals.
facts.expected_handling: Require fuel-sales reconciliation before accepting shipping totals.

facts.source_fact: Shipping activity coverage was enhanced using global AIS data from 2019 rather than the older UK AIS basis.
facts.expected_handling: Carry AIS coverage vintage in shipping provenance.

facts.source_fact: At-berth shipping emissions are now assigned to domestic shipping only to remove double counting.
facts.expected_handling: Reject records that simultaneously count the same at-berth emissions in domestic and international shipping.

facts.source_fact: Industrial-wastewater discharge emissions were added to totals for the first time under newer IPCC/Paris reporting guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Mark historic series as structurally revised when a new source category is introduced.

facts.source_fact: Biogas and natural-gas use from the gas distribution network are now estimated separately using DUKES biogas-injection data.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge fossil and biogenic gas use when the revised source separates them.

facts.source_fact: A five-year average is applied to iron-and-steel fuel data for 2022 to 2024 to improve alignment after coke-oven closures.
facts.expected_handling: Carry smoothing-method metadata for those years.

facts.source_fact: Gas-oil sector activity uses interpolation or extrapolation for specified historic periods while remaining consistent with DUKES totals.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish adjusted sector allocation from national fuel-use totals.

facts.source_fact: Peat estimates use a higher calorific value and revised Northern Ireland carbon content to better reflect UK use cases.
facts.expected_handling: Record country-specific factor overrides.

facts.source_fact: HFC emissions from fluoropolymer production were added using Pollution Inventory and Environment Agency site-level data.
facts.expected_handling: Require source-level provenance for the newly included HFC category.

facts.source_fact: Domestic wood combustion now uses a direct DUKES breakdown of heating-degree-day and stock impacts.
facts.expected_handling: Prefer the revised direct DUKES decomposition over the superseded gas-based proxy.

facts.source_fact: Agriculture modelling uses country-specific low-emission slurry-spreading uptake data for England and Great Britain data for other UK nations as described.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve territorial data-source differences in agriculture modelling.

facts.source_fact: LULUCF revisions include forest-carbon, peatland, cropland and activity-data improvements.
facts.expected_handling: Treat LULUCF revisions as multi-component model changes rather than a single factor change.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting, monitoring or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference year, publication/update date and provisional/final status where applicable.
Carry source URL, publisher and method/provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert this method or regulatory rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
